market.title: Big Brother 28 — Week 4 Eviction
resolutionNote: Resolves on the live Week 4 eviction episode - whichever of the three current nominees gets voted out by the house.

Taylor Brown won the Power of Veto and removed herself at Monday's ceremony, and HOH Haley Thogmartin named Lyric Medeiros as the replacement nominee - so the block is now Drew Campbell, Melody Morris, and Lyric Medeiros.

All three get one final shot at safety in the BB Block Buster competition during Thursday's live episode. Whoever wins it is safe; the eviction vote happens between the two who don't, so only one of the three tracked outcomes below will actually go home.
Kalshi's own wording: "If [houseguest] is officially eliminated from Big Brother Season 28 Before Aug 7, 2026, then the market resolves to Yes."
Kalshi-only - Polymarket doesn't list a matching single-week eviction contract for this show, only the season-long winner market.

text: Since she won Head of Household in Week 4, Haley Thogmartin had the power to nominate Drew Campbell, Melody Morris, and Taylor Brown for eviction.
Drew had been playing both sides of the house, and nominating him was a strategic gamble by Haley's alliance since it offers him two chances to save himself.
It was Taylor Brown, however, that won Power of Veto, and so she made it off the chopping block, leaving just Drew, Melody, and Lyric (as her replacement).
Kalshi has Drew as the clear favorite to go, at more than 60%.
